Case: Patient D is a 35-year-old Black man who presents to your emergency room with complaints of severe abdominal and pelvic pain. Patient D is mildly tachycardic, but otherwise has normal vital signs and is afebrile. Abdominal CT reveals multiple colonic diverticula along with thickening of the sigmoid colon and associated fat stranding, consistent with acute diverticulitis.
